findings.explanation: You will not receive payment until 90 days after invoicing, which creates a long cash‑flow delay.
You will not receive payment until 90 days after invoicing, which delays cash flow and increases financial risk.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before signing, I would like to suggest a couple of small adjustments to the agreement:
- The relevant clause states “Invoices are payable Net 90.” This creates a long cash‑flow delay; I propose changing it to “Invoices are payable Net 30.”
- The relevant clause states “Payment period: Net 90.” This also delays cash flow and raises financial risk; I propose changing it to “Payment period: Net 30.”

Thank you for considering these updates. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
